turns.text: so i bombed an apush reading quiz this morning and honestly i dont care lol. stayed late at the robotics build in C7 last night and skipped the reading. need a makeup plan thats not a big deal, i dont want to email my teacher a whole essay about it

Short and low-drama works best. Here's a plan:

1. Email your teacher tonight or before first period tomorrow. Two or three sentences: you missed the reading, the quiz didn't go well, and you'd like to know if there's a makeup or a way to earn some points back.
2. Don't over-explain. One clause about a schedule conflict is plenty.
3. Do the reading in a single 30-40 minute block this weekend so you're caught up before the next quiz.

Draft:

Hi [teacher name], I didn't finish the reading for today's quiz and it showed. Is there a makeup or a reading response I could do to make up the points? I can turn something in by [date]. Thanks, [your name]

Want me to adjust the tone?
thats good. genuinely not worth stressing over, the drivetrain prototype ran today so the build crunch was worth it, im mechanical lead so i kinda had to be there

Congrats on getting the prototype running, that's a real milestone. Since the build matters to you, you could add one line to the email saying you'll plan ahead for the next reading around your robotics evenings. Optional, but it makes the ask sound reliable. Otherwise the draft is ready to send.

ok. also im filling out the state university summer engineering institute app, due nov 15, and i need to budget time for it. it wants my date of birth, i typed 03/14/2009 in the field. is that the right way to format it

Format depends on the form. Look near the field for a hint like MM/DD/YYYY, a placeholder, or a dropdown. US forms most often want MM/DD/YYYY, so what you typed matches that pattern. If it rejects the entry, try the other order or add leading zeros. If it's a date picker, click it rather than typing.

For the Nov 15 deadline, work backward:
- Finish the short-answer sections first
- Leave a few days before the deadline for a final read-through
- Submit at least a day early in case the portal is slow

Want a week-by-week schedule?
yeah short version. then ok bye

Short version:

- This week: gather the required info and sections
- Next week: draft short answers
- Week of Oct 27: revise and ask someone to read it
- Week of Nov 3: final edits, check every field
- By Nov 12-13: submit, with buffer before the 15th

Good luck with the email. Bye!
